# Draft:Simeonkwartet

----
R
Simeonkwartet is a Dutch piano quartet that performs compositions by the composer Simeon ten Holt..
History
The quartet was founded in 1996 by pianists Rien Wulffraat and Emile Engel with the intention to learn and perform Simeon ten Holt’s Canto Ostinato together. Fellow colleagues José de Bree and Elisabeth Reindersma joined them to complete the quartet. They recorded their first album in 1998.
The members have changed over the years, whereby pianists Wiebe Kaspers and Afke Wiersma have briefly performed in the quartet. Cathelijne Maat then joined the group followed by Esther Scheerder. Jacobus den Herder was the most recent addition to the quartet which accounts for the current arrangement. The quartet performs in various locations throughout the Netherlands including annual performances at the Hanzehof in Zutphen. They have also performed internationally, including Belgium and Romania.
Simeon ten Holt
Rien Wulffraat had personal correspondence with Simeon ten Holt. Rien requested permission to use his (Simeon's) name for the quartet, which was granted. Rien sent recordings of the quartet’s performances and Simeon ten Holt would respond with a critical analysis of the recordings, ranging from ‘beautiful performance’ to ‘never perform it again!'.
Esther Scheerder, who joined the group later, also had a personal connection with the composer, as she had previously been a student of his. During this time she studied his compositions and she would perform after his public talks.
Repertoire
The quartet usually performs the popular minimalist composition Canto Ostinato, but they have also performed some of Simeon ten Holt’s other compositions for four pianos, namely Méandres and Incantation IV.
Concerts
Canto Ostinato is made up of numerous sections that can be played an indeterminate amount of times and is decided live by the players. Jacobus den Herder is designated as the primary player within the group and determines when they move to the next section. The concerts are often accompanied by light shows and in many cases, the audience can also lie down during the concert. A concert from 2019 was publicly broadcast on NPO Radio 4 (now NPO Klassiek) "Avondconcert" programme and excerpts of their performance are featured a few times a year on the radio station.
The group have been involved in a few cultural initiatives, including Catharina's Winter in Doetinchem, CODA Classique, Young in Europe: Sibiu meets Deventer, Hoogtij Festival, Klassiek in de Beurs and Finirama Kunstcarrousel
Discography
* 1998 - Canto Ostinato
* 2002 - Méandres
* 2023 - Canto Ostinato - Four piano version
